117539.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Arizona
117539.note: Jewish News of Greater Phoenix (8 June 2026, 'Chabad celebrates 50 years in Arizona'): 'Shortly after arriving in January 1977, Zalman and Tzipi mailed over 5,000 shalach manos'; 'Chabad also organized a megillah reading in February 1977'. The Jewish News (8 Feb 2002, its 25th anniversary): 'The synagogue first met in a garage at Third Avenue and McDowell Road. In 1978, Chabad moved to Maryland Avenue and 15th Street'; 'In 1990, the congregation moved to its current location at 2110 E. Lincoln Drive in Phoenix' (bought in 1989, per the 2026 article). One Jewish News piece (2 June 2026) has them moving to Phoenix 'in 1976'.

earlier.where: a garage at Third Avenue and McDowell Road, Phoenix

117540.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Tucson
117540.note: Jewish News of Greater Phoenix (8 Feb 2002): 'In 1984, Rabbi Yossi and Chana Shemtov started Chabad of Tucson.' Medium: the Arizona Jewish Post (16 Feb 2017) has 1983: 'The expansion of Chabad to other cities in Arizona began in 1983, when Rabbi Yossie and Chanie Shemtov were sent by the Rebbe to establish Chabad Tucson and Chabad activities at the University of Arizona.' Its own About page gives no year. At 2443 East 4th Street (Young Israel-Chabad Tucson) today.

117912.name: Chabad of Scottsdale
117912.note: lubavitch.com (4 Oct 2021, 'Scottsdale's Jewish Community Turns Thirty'): 'When Rabbi Yossi and Dina Levertov moved to Scottsdale in 1992'. The Jewish News (8 Feb 2002): 'In 1992, Levertov's brother, Rabbi Yossi Levertov, started Chabad of Scottsdale with his wife Dina.' The Jewish News 'Synagogue timeline' (17 Aug 2007): '1992 Chabad of Scottsdale'. COLlive (10 Feb 2017): 'the 25th anniversary of Chabad of Scottsdale'. Now The Weksler Chabad Center, 10215 North Scottsdale Road.

119846.name: Mazal Tov Gifts - Book Store
119846.note: No year of its own: Chabad of Scottsdale's gift shop, a department of Chabad of Scottsdale (117912, 1992) on chabad.org. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

3012050.name: Kosher Restaurant (Kitchen 18)
3012050.note: The listing's site is Thekitchen18.com, a department of Chabad of Scottsdale on chabad.org. The Jewish News (31 Jan 2013): 'The restaurant that was part of Scottsdale Café Market and Deli has transformed into Kitchen 18, a kosher restaurant'; '(Kitchen 18 is supervised by Chabad.)' Medium: new in Jan 2013, so it may have opened late in 2012. Its chabad.org listing went up July 21 2015.

118252.name: Chabad of the East Valley
118252.note: The Jewish News (21 Nov 1997, 'Chabad programs under way in Chandler'): 'Chabad of the Southeast Valley started out this year with more than 100 people attending its High Holiday services at the Chandler Windmill Inn'; the money 'went to hire 24-year-old Rabbi Mendy Deitsch of Crown Heights, N.Y., to head the organization'. The Jewish News 'Synagogue timeline' (2007): '1997 Chabad of the East Valley'. Now 875 North McClintock Drive.

118414.name: Chabad of the West Valley
118414.note: The Jewish News (1 Sept 2000, 'Chabad opens in Glendale'): 'Chabad of the West Valley, under the leadership of Rabbi Sholom Lew, will open its doors in late September for Rosh Hashana'; 'Located on the grounds of Benley Manor, a kosher retirement community opening soon in Glendale'. The 2007 'Synagogue timeline': '2000 Chabad of the West Valley'. Now 6635 W Happy Valley Road.

earlier.where: the grounds of Benley Manor, a kosher retirement community, Glendale

118615.name: Chabad at Arizona State University
118615.note: The Jewish News (19 Sept 2003, 'Chabad presence at ASU'): 'Rabbi Shmuel Tiechtel, along with his wife, Chana, and infant son, Tzvi, will arrive in Tempe from Brooklyn, N.Y., after the High Holidays.' The 2007 'Synagogue timeline': '2003 Chabad at ASU'. At 971 S. Ash Ave. (the Rohr Chabad House) by 2007, as today.

150719.name: Chabad Lubavitch of North Phoenix
150719.note: The Jewish News (9 April 2004, 'Chabad to expand to North Valley'): 'Rabbi Mendy Levertov, son of Rabbi Zalman and Tzipi Levertov, who founded Chabad of Arizona 27 years ago, will begin programming for Chabad of North Phoenix after Passover.' 'Initially, he and his wife Leah will offer classes in private homes.' The 2007 'Synagogue timeline': '2004 Chabad of North Phoenix'. Now 22044 North 44th Street.

350478.name: Chabad of Anthem
350478.note: The Jewish News (26 Aug 2005, 'Chabad comes to Anthem'): 'Chabad of Arizona plans to open a center in Anthem and to offer Talmud Torah in the young community north of Phoenix beginning Sept. 18.' Before that: 'In May 2004, Levertov met with 35 Jewish residents of Anthem, which led to his son-in-law Rabbi Yossi Friedman leading High Holiday services at the Hampton Inn there last October.' The 2007 'Synagogue timeline': '2005 Chabad of Anthem'.

625537.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Mesa
625537.note: The Arizona Republic (22 Sept 2006, reposted on 'Lubavitch In the News'): 'Chabad of Arizona will hold Rosh Hashana services at the Mesa Convention Center'; '"We're looking at the prospects of opening a Chabad center in Mesa," Blotner said.' By Dec 2006 the Jewish News listed a 'Chabad of Mesa' public menorah lighting, and its 2007 'Synagogue timeline' has '2006 Chabad of Mesa'. Rabbi Laibel (Laib) Blotner leads it; now 941 S Maple. Its chabad.org listing went up Jan 14 2008.

359494.name: Chabad of Flagstaff
359494.note: The Jewish News (17 Feb 2006, 'Chabad opens new center in Flagstaff'): 'Chabad of Arizona is opening a new center in Flagstaff next week. Rabbi Dovie Shapiro and his wife, Chaya, will move from Brooklyn, N.Y., to open Chabad of Flagstaff at 22 E. Elm Ave. in downtown Flagstaff'. Now 930 W University Avenue.

157392.name: Arizona Jewish Russian Programs
157392.note: The Jewish News (12 Jan 2001, 'Free to be Jewish'): 'Hence the foundation of Chabad Russian Programs, headquartered in the Chabad-Lubavitch Center in Phoenix and directed by Rabbi Dan Hayman. In the four years since the programs' inception, they have served more than 2,000 new Americans.' Counted back: about 1997, medium. Its chabad.org listing went up July 29 2004.

976025.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Fountain Hills
976025.note: lubavitch.com (3 Oct 2018): 'Since their arrival in 2010 until this month, the Lipskiers have led services and communal events from their home and office on a quiet residential street.' The Jewish News (on COLlive, 2 Oct 2018): 'Lipskier founded Chabad of Fountain Hills in 2010'. Its new home, the Chabad Edelman Jewish Center at 16830 E. Avenue of the Fountains (the former Gridley's store), opened for Rosh Hashana 2018. Its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on Aug 31 2009.

earlier.where: the Lipskiers' home and office, Fountain Hills

992582.name: Chabad of Downtown
992582.note: The Jewish News (2 Feb 2021): 'Levertov's son, Rabbi Levi Levertov, started the work of building a Chabad presence downtown 11 years ago, while also launching and directing Smile on Seniors Arizona.' Its first full-time couple, Rabbi Dovber and Chana Dechter, the directors now, 'moved to Phoenix this December' (Dec 2020; lubavitch.com, 24 Aug 2021). Medium: a count back, and its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on Sept 29 2009. Now 1515 West Palm Lane.

1090387.name: Smile on Seniors
1090387.note: The Jewish News ('Valley View', 18 Dec 2009): Chabad 'launched a volunteer program to serve senior citizens in the Metro Phoenix area on a daily basis'; 'The national program will be coordinated and run locally by Rabbi Levi Levertov and his wife, Chani.' Its chabad.org listing went up Jan 14 2010.

4540280.name: Jewish Care Network
4540280.note: The Jewish News (26 Oct 2021): Rabbi Moshe and Sashie Levertov: 'Last year, the couple launched the Jewish Care Network to ensure that people don't face an illness alone.' Medium: its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on Nov 4 2019. At 2110 E Lincoln Drive (Chabad of Arizona).

5276310.name: Cteen Phoenix
5276310.note: The Jewish News's review of 5771 (23 Sept 2011): 'Chabad of Arizona hires Rabbi Dov Levertov to run C-Teen, a new program for Jewish teens throughout the Valley' (so 2010-11). This listing (Rabbi Tzvi and Masha Rimler, at 2110 E Lincoln Drive) went up Oct 12 2021; that it is the same program isn't shown, so kept as a range by its listing date.

1184673.name: Camp Gan Izzy
1184673.note: No year of its own: Chabad Tucson's day camp (a department of 117540), run by Feigie Ceitlin, youth director of Chabad of Tucson. The Arizona Jewish Post (15 June 2012): 'Chabad's Camp Gan Izzy, for ages 2-12, runs June 25-July 20', with 'three of last year's out-of-town counselors' returning. Its chabad.org listing went up April 20 2010, so it existed by then.

455508.name: Chabad on River
455508.note: No start date found. Rabbi Rami and Chani Bigelman's center: the Jewish News (8 Feb 2002): 'Rabbi Rami and Chana Bigelman joined them in 2000' (Chabad of Tucson); the Arizona Jewish Post (24 March 2011): 'Chabad on River will welcome its first Sefer Torah on Sunday, April 10'. Its chabad.org listing went up Dec 12 2006, so it existed by then. Now 3916 E Fort Lowell Road.

5607924.name: Chabad House at the University of Arizona
5607924.note: Arizona Jewish Post (on CrownHeights.info, 22 June 2006): Rabbi Yossie Winner, 25, 'moved to Tucson last July from Brooklyn with his wife, Naomi, 23, to establish a Chabad House on the University of Arizona campus.' Chabad was 'active on the UA campus in the early 1980s' through Chabad Tucson (Arizona Jewish Post, 14 July 2015). The Winners hosted students in their two-bedroom house and a backyard tent until the Rohr Chabad Jewish Student Center at 1436 E. Drachman, this listing's address, was built (expected to open Dec 2015). Medium: this listing went up only on Oct 25 2022 and names Rabbi Shmulie and Sarah Shanowitz.

earlier.where: the Winners' two-bedroom house and a backyard tent, near Euclid Avenue and Speedway Boulevard, Tucson

1279033.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Goodyear
1279033.note: The Jewish News ('Valley View', 17 June 2011, 'Chabad opens center in Goodyear'): 'Rabbi Berel and Chana Zaklikovsky moved to Arizona from Brooklyn, N.Y., last week to start Chabad Jewish Center of Goodyear.' Before that he 'visited Arizona last December to host a menorah-lighting celebration at Goodyear Community Park'. Its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on Aug 19 2010. Now 14295 W La Reata Avenue.

1681679.name: Chabad of Gilbert Jewish Center
1681679.note: East Valley Tribune (on CrownHeights.info, 6 Sept 2012): Rabbi Shimi Ash and his wife, Chavie, with their son 'moved about two months ago from New York' to establish the Chabad Jewish Center, in time for the High Holidays. Its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on Nov 17 2011. Now 4475 E. Carriage Way.

1689667.name: Chabad of Oro Valley
1689667.note: Arizona Jewish Post (17 May 2012): 'Chabad of Tucson has appointed Rabbi Ephraim Zimmerman to be the first full-time rabbi serving the spiritual, religious and educational needs of Oro Valley Jews.' Arizona Jewish Post (16 Feb 2017): 'In 2012, Rabbi Ephraim Zimmerman and his wife, Mushkie, were brought to Arizona to found Chabad of Oro Valley'. Its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on Nov 25 2011.

2364351.name: Chabad of Paradise Valley
2364351.note: The Jewish News (19 Feb 2014): 'Chabad of Arizona has announced the opening of a new center: Chabad of Paradise Valley. The center will be run by Rabbi Shlomy and Chaya Levertov.' Its first programs, among them 'a Shabbat dinner scheduled for March 14', were to be held in a private home. Its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on Oct 29 2013.

2666160.name: Chabad of Prescott
2666160.note: The Jewish News (10 Dec 2014): 'Rabbi Elie and Bracha Filler recently relocated to Prescott to open Chabad of Prescott and plan to hold its first event during Hanukkah.' Its chabad.org listing went up Aug 21 2014. Now 418 N Washington Ave.

3181882.name: Chabad of Cochise County
3181882.note: lubavitch.com (22 Aug 2016, 'Chabad Opens in Cochise County, Arizona'): the Jews of the county 'convinced Rabbi Bentzion and Chaya Shemtov to move down there with their two children, and open a Chabad House'; 'the twenty-first branch of Chabad Lubavitch to open in the state of Arizona, and the first in Cochise County'. COLlive (2 Jan 2026): 'We arrived in Sierra Vista just before Rosh Hashanah of 2016'. Its chabad.org listing went up Jan 26 2016.

3590177.name: Chabad of Sedona
3590177.note: No start date found (its own site gives none). Rabbi Mendel and Fraydee Kessler; the Jewish News (28 Jan 2020): 'Rabbi Mendel Kessler is the spiritual leader of Chabad of Sedona.' Its chabad.org listing went up March 13 2017, so it existed by then. Now 140 Coffee Pot Drive.

4927362.name: Chabad of Casa Grande
4927362.note: COLlive (25 Jan 2021): 'Rabbi Moshe and Chaya Sasonkin (nee Bigelman) were appointed as the first Shluchim to Casa Grande'; 'the Sasonkis say they are looking forward to moving down there'. ChabadInfo (25 Jan 2021): 'After visiting Casa Grande, AZ in 2020 Rabbi Moshe & Chaya Sasonkin decided to relocate and establish a Chabad Center'. Medium: its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on Nov 10 2020.

5157809.name: Chabad of Vail, Arizona
5157809.note: The Vail Voice (4 Aug 2021, 'Vail Gets First Rabbi'): 'In time for the upcoming High Holidays, Rabbi Sruly and Chavie Shemtov from Brooklyn, NY, are set to establish a new Chabad Jewish Center'. COLlive (21 July 2021): they 'have established Chabad Jewish Center in Vail'. Its chabad.org listing went up June 17 2021.

5370570.name: Chabad on 7th Street
5370570.note: No start date found: Rabbi Buzzy and Chaya Ajzenszmidt's 'Chabad 7th - Serving the 7th Street community' (its site, read through Firecrawl, gives no year; no news found). Its chabad.org listing went up Jan 18 2022, so it existed by then.

5529178.name: Chabad Israeli Center
5529178.note: No start date found: Rabbi Shneor and Chanie Feigin's Israeli center (its site, read through Firecrawl, gives no year; an Anash announcement could not be read). Its chabad.org listing went up June 16 2022, so it existed by then. Now 4523 E Hearn Road.

5566144.name: Chabad of Lake Havasu City
5566144.note: CrownHeights.info (13 Nov 2022): Rabbi Mendel and Itta Super 'are moving in just three weeks to build the only Chabad House in Arizona's largest and most isolated county'. Its chabad.org listing went up July 6 2022. Now 116 Acoma Blvd N.

5590394.name: Chabad of Downtown - South Scottsdale
5590394.note: The Jewish News (4 March 2025): 'The Bronsteins took the helm of the Chabad Young Professionals of Scottsdale group in 2022', and later 'moved to open Chabad of Old Town-South Scottsdale'. Its chabad.org listing (Rabbi Shmuli and Mushkie Bronstein, young professionals) went up Oct 24 2022. Medium: when the Old Town center itself opened isn't stated.

5597418.name: Chabad of Ahwatukee
5597418.note: The Jewish News (25 Jan 2023): Rabbi Levi and Chaya Minsky: 'A couple of months ago, not long before Chanukah, their shared dream became a reality'; they 'arrived in Ahwatukee, a small city in the East Valley'. Its chabad.org listing went up Oct 25 2022.

5818525.name: Chabad Bukharian Center
5818525.note: The Jewish News (3 Oct 2023, 'Phoenix Bukharian synagogue reopens under new leadership'): 'The CBC is the new iteration of what had been the Bukharian Jewish Congress of Arizona, which closed its doors in 2021'; 'Rabbi Emanuel Shimonov is the center's new spiritual leader.' Its chabad.org listing went up March 16 2023. At 17421 N 6th Place.

5954255.name: Chabad of Moon Valley & GCU
5954255.note: CrownHeights.info (9 Aug 2023): 'Rabbi Shneur and Esther Wolfman have been announced as the newest Shluchim heading to the city'. The Jewish News (21 Dec 2023): 'On Dec. 10, Chabad of Moon Valley celebrated its first big community holiday event at Moon Valley Park in Phoenix', by 'The recently arrived shluchim'. Its chabad.org listing went up May 23 2023.

6422398.name: Chabad of Surprise
6422398.note: CrownHeights.info (6 July 2024): Rabbi Shlomy and Batya (nee Lew) Ceitlin 'will be heading to Surprise, Arizona to start a new Chabad Center for the growing Jewish population'. lubavitch.com (24 Sept 2024): 'when the Ceitlins moved to town to create a center'. Its chabad.org listing went up July 2 2024.

6448214.name: Chabad of NE Rural Arizona
6448214.note: The Jewish News (8 July 2024): Rabbi Yaakov and Tiferes Cahnman 'are heading up Chabad of Rural Arizona, a new Chabad program'; 'the first Chabad of Rural Arizona event in Pinetop-Lakeside last month' (June 2024). Its chabad.org listing went up July 17 2024 (1000 N Beeline Hwy, Payson).

6471783.name: Chabad of San Tan Valley
6471783.note: No start date found: Rabbi Mendel and Rivky Wolowik's center (its site, read through Firecrawl, gives no year; no news found). Its chabad.org listing went up July 17 2024, so it existed by then.

6659224.name: Chabad of Buckeye
6659224.note: lubavitch.com (22 July 2025): 'This summer, Rabbi Mendy and Shterna Goldstein launched Chabad of Buckeye to serve the city's estimated 1,000 Jews'. Its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on Nov 18 2024.

7343104.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Maricopa City
7343104.note: The Jewish News (2 June 2026): Chabad of Arizona is 'marking its half-century anniversary with the opening of a brand-new Carefree center, as well as a center in Maricopa.' Rabbi Dov Ber and Rivka Fridman; its chabad.org listing went up May 26 2026.

7369479.name: Chabad of Carefree
7369479.note: The Jewish News (2 June 2026): 'Chabad of Arizona recently announced that it is expanding to incorporate a new Chabad center, bringing Jewish learning and connection to the North Valley communities of Carefree and Cave Creek.' Rabbi Mendel and Mussie Heller; its chabad.org listing went up June 15 2026.
